name: DEFAULT_CRITIC_STEPS_PER_ACTOR
desc: Paper default: K critic updates per actor update.

name: TRAIN_QUIET_S
desc: Training is quiescent once the step count holds for this long: longer than one step, or the drain would return while the rollout's last batch is still training.

name: INFERENCE_TIMEOUT_S
desc: The seconds a run waits for inference to start the scenario's model before it stops.

name: LEASE_CHECK_S
desc: The seconds between two checks of a running trial's lease.

name: MAX_PARAMETERS
desc: The most parameters that one PostgreSQL statement takes.

name: PROMPT_SESSION_CHARS
desc: The prompt Designer reads the session from its prompt: the eval's session budget.

name: CLOSE_GRACE_S
desc: How long ``close()`` lets in-flight jobs finish before cancelling.

name: SANDBOX_MAX_TIMEOUT_S
desc: The longest life Modal grants a sandbox.

name: CALIBRATION_ERRORS
desc: The calibration's result keeps the errors of this many rollouts.

name: NOT_A_FACTORY
desc: A value a runtime kind reference can name that is not a factory class.

name: INFERENCE_TIMEOUT_S
desc: The seconds that ``setup`` waits for inference to serve the scenario's model.

name: RECORD_TEXT_CAP
desc: Characters kept per text in a record; a longer text ends in a clip marker.

name: TREE_W
desc: The tree box is narrower than a column, so the render arrow has room for its label.

name: LR_WARMUP_STEPS
desc: serve.yaml's lr-warmup-iters; Megatron requires the decay span to be longer.

name: trial_record
doc: One trial as the ``reef_terminus.trajectory.TrialReader`` reader expects it, its steps read from ``trial_dir`` alone.

name: tool_calls
doc: The tools a pi session called and the ones that failed, in order, each cut to what a reader needs.

name: check_job
doc: Raise ``ValueError`` for a job this component cannot train. The default accepts every job.

name: require_score
doc: Read a finite reward for a training method that needs one.

name: task_paths
doc: Refuse dataset drift before running any paid run.

name: pending_stops
doc: The set of the stops that the store holds, without their order: each route that left the published

name: write_tree
doc: Write ``files`` under ``root``; the native root inside.

name: __call__
doc: Refuse unisolated Python and local Docker nested in Reef's jail.

name: test_codex_takes_no_config_key_from_a_tree
doc: A Codex plugin carries no config key, so config.toml holds the run's defaults and the binding alone.

name: served_artifact
doc: No route for any artifact: this runtime serves no requests.

name: rollout_settings
doc: The ``rollout`` parameter of a task job. ``ValueError``: it is missing, malformed or has an unknown key.

name: register_routes
doc: The routes of control's app. It serves the data routes too when its process runs the data service.

name: sdft_actor_pre_train
doc: Move the teacher toward the policy (seeding it on the first step), then score every teacher sequence.

name: ensure_scenario
doc: Create the scenario, with its root snapshot, if it does not exist yet; its harness manifest.
